title: Parkour Elements
description: This mod adds new blocks and items useful for parkour maps!
body:
# Parkour Elements
## A parkour Minecraft mod

This mod adds new blocks useful for parkour maps, like the `Trampoline`, the `Hazard`, the `Coin` and the `Portal` block.

![mod things](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b56bb48a7198cea8fb696d95b399c5eda6b3cba.png)

The `Trampoline` makes you jump higher, the `Hazard Block` kills you, the `Coin Block` once touched gives you coins and the `Portal Block` teleports you in a random location of the world. LoL

> Made with [MCreator](https://mcreator.net/)
